zh: 好子序列里出现的每个字符次数都相同，设这个共同次数为 k；每个非空好子序列恰好对应一个 k，所以可以按 k 分类计数再求和。
固定 k 后，各字符之间相互独立：出现次数 cnt 不少于 k 的字符，要么不选，要么从它的 cnt 个位置中选 k 个，共 C(cnt,k) 种。把每个字符的“1 加 C(cnt,k)”相乘，再减去所有字符都不选的那一种。
统计 26 个字母的出现次数，预处理阶乘和阶乘的逆元（模 1000000007，用费马小定理求逆元），以 O(1) 计算组合数。对 k 从 1 到最大出现次数，把所有次数不少于 k 的字母的 C(cnt,k)+1 连乘，减 1 后加入答案，全程取模。
en: In a good subsequence every character that appears has the same count k, and each non-empty good subsequence has exactly one such k, so count by k and add up.

For a fixed k the characters are independent: a character with cnt≥k occurrences is either skipped or contributes k of its cnt positions, in C(cnt,k) ways. Multiply 1+C(cnt,k) over those characters and subtract the one choice that picks nothing.

Count the 26 letters and precompute factorials and inverse factorials modulo 1000000007 (inverses via Fermat's little theorem) to get binomial coefficients in O(1). For k from 1 to the largest count, multiply C(cnt,k)+1 over the letters with count at least k, subtract 1, and add it to the answer, all modulo the prime.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Enumerate the common frequency k. For each character that appears at least k times, either choose its indices in C(count,k) ways or leave the character out; the option where nothing is chosen must be excluded.

## Proof of correctness

Every non-empty good subsequence has a unique positive frequency k. For a fixed k, the index choices of different characters are independent, so the product enumerates every subsequence in which each present character appears exactly k times; subtracting the empty choice leaves only non-empty ones. Summing over all k counts nothing twice.

## Complexity

Time O(n+26·maxCount), space O(n).
